name: Blood Fast
description: A vampiric fast of abstaining from blood that drives the faster mad with hunger.

description_citations.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

pages_say.description: A vampire rite of abstention from blood that ends in sudden, explosive violence when the paladin gives in to hunger.
